title: GridShell /host + /mcp response envelope
description: Sent by a /host client in reply to a request-envelope message; forwarded verbatim by server.py back to the /mcp client that made the call. server.py also synthesizes an error envelope itself (never a success one) when no /host client is connected, or when the /host client doesn't reply before the request's timeoutMs elapses.

result.description: Tool-specific return value - any JSON type, including null for a call with no meaningful result (e.g. a plain write).
